In this discussion you learn how to use AI tools without fabricating historical evidence.

It is run as a guided conversation, online or on your campus, and works best with a group that is ready to argue a point.

What it covers

  • Spot an AI-generated error
  • Source trace-back exercise
  • Discuss image reconstruction disclosure
  • Build a verification checklist

How the time is spent

  1. Spot an AI-generated error 15 min

  2. Source trace-back exercise 30 min

  3. Discuss image reconstruction disclosure 35 min

  4. Build a verification checklist 20 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Spot errors in AI-generated historical content before they are treated as evidence.
  • Trace a historical claim back to its source to check whether it holds.
  • Build a verification checklist and decide when an image reconstruction needs disclosure.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
